comments.note: computeEffectiveStatus extracted from gui/orchestrator-manager.ts into src/gui/queue/compute-effective-status.ts following the same pattern as resolve-progress.ts. orchestrator-manager.ts now imports and re-exports it. The function gained a third optional parameter hasLogActivity (default false) that is passed as progressResult.hasStageActivity in getQueue() but left at default in killQueueEntry/dismissQueueEntry per spec.

The alive+hasLogActivity rule promotes a queue entry to 'started' before project-ledger.json is created. This is observable via the GUI but not via killQueueEntry (which uses default hasLogActivity=false and still sees the entry as pending). This asymmetry is intentional per the spec but worth a comment near the kill function for future readers.
